Jerusalem sits alone like a widow, weeping. Honest grief over loss: God allows lament.
The Lord seemed like an enemy as Jerusalem fell. Under the old covenant judgement came; in Christ, God's anger fell on Jesus.
"The steadfast love of the Lord never ceases; his mercies never come to an end; they are new every morning; great is your faithfulness" (3:22-23). Hope at the heart of grief.
The horrors of the siege. Sin's full consequences; Jesus bore them so we do not have to.
"Restore us to yourself, O Lord, that we may be restored" (5:21). Restoration is God's work.
